caption: The drawing depicts a lantern with a rectangular base and four vertical sides, each forming a corner of the lantern. The lantern is predominantly composed of clear panels that suggest glass, outlined by a framework of straight edges and corners. Inside the lantern, there is a single, upright candle placed on a small cylindrical holder at the center of the base, which supports the melting candle and collects wax drippings. The top of the lantern is covered by a cylindrical cap with a slightly flared edge and a domed center. Attached to the cap is a curved handle, which is connected to a metal chain that runs down one side of the lantern, with the chain looping at the bottom and ending in a clasp or hook. The entire image is rendered in black lines on a white or off-white background, with hatching and crosshatching techniques used to indicate shading and texture. There is no evidence of color beyond black and white linework.
title: Stable Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
